THE SPATIAL ARCHITECTURE

Arranged around
an open-air sanctuary.

A harmonious horizontal layout designed for natural cross-ventilation and fluid indoor-outdoor living.

Arriving from the south entrance past the manicured motor court and landscaped garden path, you enter a central reception foyer. To the west lies an expansive open-plan great room, culinary dining suite, and chef's kitchen with a concealed prep scullery. Directly across the serene landscaped courtyard is a casual family lounge and executive study.

The eastern private wing houses a master sanctuary with an expansive walk-in dressing suite and spa ensuite, alongside two family bedrooms, an executive guest suite, and designer bath facilities. The deep north terrace connects indoor living with outdoor lounging and al fresco entertaining under the sky.

ARCHITECTURAL RECONSTRUCTION

Rigorous fidelity to
plan geometry.

Verified Spatial Axes

Reference boundaries, room adjacencies, orientation to north, and flow between social and private zones reflect the original architectural floor plan with utmost integrity.

Dimensional Standards

Wall thicknesses modeled at 190 mm, clear ceiling heights of 2.80 m, standardized glazing thresholds, and true-to-scale ergonomic interior furnishings.

Parametric Precision

Clean mathematical geometry generated with lightweight web efficiency in mind, delivering instant 60 FPS performance without bulky game engine overhead.
